title: A recorded chart
description: One implementation's answers for one moment and place, with the complete settings it computed them under and the hash of those settings. A fixture is evidence, so everything that could have moved a number is recorded beside it.

id.description: Stable for the life of the corpus: a report cites it, and a fixture that changes id is a different fixture.

chart.description: The moment and place this fixture belongs to; several fixtures may share one chart under different settings.

why.description: What this fixture is for. An entry nobody can say the purpose of is an entry nobody can maintain.

settings.description: The complete profile, not a patch: a fixture must be reproducible from itself.

sections.description: Which sections this fixture carries. Every one named here is present as a top-level object of the same name.

hash.description: The hash of the settings the numbers were computed under, so a consumer can tell whether it is comparing like with like.

evidence_rank.description: 1 a text or an institution, 2 an established implementation, 3 another implementation, 4 anything else.

ephemeris.description: The library, its version, its data files and their hashes, and the flags it was called with.

time_zones.description: Every zone database version that could have moved an instant.

conventions.description: What the numbers mean: which index starts at zero, what an angle is measured from, how a day is bounded.

local.description: The civil time as a person would state it, before any zone was applied.

resolved.description: The instant the numbers were computed for, and how the civil time became it.
